rationale: bugs_open/273 (= bugs_closed/261 §8 follow-up 2, the handoff-designated next work for this lane). The diagnosis bundle's sibling section fair-shares a 6,000-char cap per scoped file (~5-10 signature lines each) and collapses the remainder to a '+N more' marker. Since 267, a file whose whole body exceeds max_body_chars gets the honest dead-end wording '...the bare file path will NOT render... Name symbols individually.' That instruction is unsatisfiable for the elided tail: the model can only name a symbol it has been shown, and the symbols behind the marker are by construction ones retrieval did not surface (or they would be in scope). Recorded harm: run dbcc4259-ab84-494b-a48b-1df647209a40 (090 on bugs_open/236) went UNVERIFIABLE in 4 iterations while the three functions its own needed_evidence names sat behind exactly this marker in coordinator.go (169,139 bytes vs the 60,000 budget, 91 functions, ~10 shown). Fix: in exactly that dead-end branch, append the elided functions' CANONICAL handles compactly (269: bare method names resolve to the wrong body), bounded at 4,000 chars/file (measured worst real complete tail: coordinator.go 2,715 chars); past the bound, count the residual and name the code_request remedy rather than trailing off silently. The tail is exempt from the section's global guard because counting it would evict the whole section on the motivating case (one scoped over-budget file: head fills the per-file share, head+tail exceeds capChars*5/4, and the model's only map of the file becomes 'further files omitted'). Every other branch is byte-identical: could-fit and unknown-size markers unchanged, no censused marker phrase introduced ('did not fit'/'could not be read'/'read it whole'/'NO next_scope can render this path' — the 267 §4b trend queries discriminate on these). Worst-case growth is bounded and stated: capChars*5/4 + (dead-end files × 4000) beside a 60,000-char body budget. Tests are mutation-proven: with the old marker restored behind 'if false', the three positive tests fail and the byte-identity pin passes.
